articles.title: Proposed 31.4% French tax on regulated stablecoins could drive crypto traders offshore
articles.snippet: Chainalysis' regional sales director in France Francois Volpoet warned the proposed 31.4% tax on regulated stablecoins could push traders toward unmonitored offshore channels.

articles.title: EU authority classifies Circle’s USDC as ‘significant’ under MiCA
articles.snippet: The second-largest stablecoin by market cap will be overseen by French and EU authorities under its classification as a “significant e-money token.“

articles.title: Standard Chartered pushes $2T stablecoin forecast to 2030 as transaction volumes grow
articles.snippet: The bank identified four distinct stablecoin markets, with USDC leading payments and AI transactions as competition intensifies over reserve yields.

articles.title: Qivalis wins Dutch e-money license for euro stablecoin
articles.snippet: Qivalis said the Electronic Money Institution authorization enables it to launch a euro-denominated stablecoin, with issuance planned for the coming months, subject to additional MiCA requirements.

articles.title: Standard Chartered Will Hold Ripple's Stablecoin in Dubai—And Let Clients Trade With It Without Moving It
articles.snippet: The bank's Dubai branch now offers custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin and plans a link with LMAX that lets institutions post it as trading collateral while the coins stay put.
